title: When CoT Obfuscation Meets Untrusted Monitoring: A Compound-Failure Matrix

original_idea.body: Build a tiny control game varying policy obfuscation level and monitor trust assumption in a 3x2 matrix, measuring detection rate per cell to quantify super-additive compounding.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Super-additive compounding of obfuscation plus collusion would undermine control safety-case math.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: 3x2 control-game matrix with prompted obfuscation; clear methodology via API.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused 3x2 matrix; small control-game harness is a manageable dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable cheap diagnostic, public models, lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: API/open-model inference on a few tasks.

novelty.reasoning: Obfuscation and collusion studied separately; the joint compound matrix may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Each failure mode studied; their explicit interaction matrix may be open.
